text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Use a 2px solid ring with a 4px outer glow at 5:1 contrast. This balances visibility for keyboard users with reduced-motion needs—glow fades instantly on interaction, avoiding animation. The 5:1 contrast ensures clarity for low-vision users without overwhelming others. Trade-off: the glow adds slight visual noise, but it’s temporary and improves usability more than it distracts.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring with 4px glow still fails reduced-motion users: the glow’s instant fade is a hack, not a fix. A 4px solid ring at 5:1 contrast meets WCAG without animation—no trade-offs. Test both in a screen-reader session: if the glow flickers or the ring blurs on patterned backgrounds, the solid ring wins.
